'''Tweedledee Deep Hatred for Jedi's''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tweedledee]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
